name: workshop-practice
description: Workshop practice for the trades — layout, setup, safety, sequencing, and the practical discipline of running a shop. Covers bench organization, jig and fixture thinking, lighting and power, dust and noise, tool maintenance cadence, and the apprenticeship-era wisdom of "a place for everything." Use when setting up a new workshop, diagnosing why an existing shop is losing time, or teaching a learner how a shop works before they touch a tool.
